intent: A reference image intended for image-to-3D generation must isolate the asset cleanly; the current cluttered background competes with the object and will confuse mesh reconstruction.
subject: The market lamp prop, intended as a clean isolated reference plate.
camera: Straight-on reference framing, plain background, even studio-style coverage.
preserve: the prop itself, fully in frame
consistent scale and lighting on the object
change: cluttered background props competing for attention
overlapping foreground elements obscuring the object's edges
avoid: any background element brighter or busier than the asset
a frame too cluttered for clean 3D reconstruction
